title: cynanchum decaisneanum
intro: Cynanchum decaisneanum, commonly known as Decaisne's swallowwort, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchum decaisneanum include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
